The build downloads SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 from its official CDN and verifies its SHA-256 digest before serving it from this directory. SheetJS is licensed under Apache-2.0. Its copyright and license notice are retained in xlsx.full.min.js. Source and license: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/ .

The browser loads this local script only when the contact importer or its blank template is used. The workbook is parsed in browser memory. No workbook is sent to SheetJS, ChatGPT or another parsing service.
